subject: walkthrough-verbatim.test.js cannot reach GUI-only paths, so every box's button surfaces are unverified by it
description: Nancy verified this from the source, 2026-09-14: _tools/hexos/walkthrough-verbatim.test.js clicks only Start/Skip/ticket-select/terminal-open, then executes commands lifted from fenced blocks via t._execute(). It has no path that clicks a Services-panel Start/Stop/Restart button or drives _openPrinterProperties. That is by design -- it replays what the walkthrough PRINTS AT A PROMPT, which is what caught pr001's wmic defect and the Clear hint. But it means any defect on a GUI-only path, or on a path the box recommends without documenting, is invisible to it. pr001's four-site Clear defect was found by review, not by the tool. Every other box carries the same exposure. NOT a reason to distrust the tool's positive findings -- a transcript it produces is real. It is a reason not to read a clean verbatim run as 'this box is verified'. Consider a companion that enumerates every interactive control the box renders per scenario and reports which were never exercised, so the unexercised surface is visible rather than assumed empty.
